tools.name: render_html_to_pdf
tools.description: Render a full HTML document to a PDF. External subresources are blocked for safety — inline images/fonts as data: URIs. Returns a file_id (for chaining) and a ~1h download URL.

tools.name: number_pdf
tools.description: Stamp a page number on every page. position: bottom-center (default) | bottom-left | bottom-right | top-center | top-left | top-right. format supports {n} and {total}. Returns a file_id + ~1h URL.

tools.name: pdf_info
tools.description: Read a PDF's metadata (title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, dates) plus page count and page size, as JSON.

tools.name: set_pdf_metadata
tools.description: Set a PDF's title, author, subject, keywords (array or comma string) and/or creator. Only the fields you provide change. Returns a file_id + ~1h URL.

tools.name: render_document
tools.description: Render a structured document to a PDF from a named template (invoice, receipt, report). Money/totals are computed for you. Returns a file_id (for chaining) and a ~1h download URL.

tools.name: merge_pdfs
tools.description: Combine 2+ PDFs into a single PDF, in the order given. Inputs are file_ids (from prior tools) or base64 PDFs. Returns a file_id (for chaining) and a ~1h download URL.

tools.name: select_pages
tools.description: Keep only the specified pages of a PDF (e.g. [1,3,5]) and drop the rest, preserving order. Returns a file_id (for chaining) and a ~1h download URL.

tools.name: rotate_pdf
tools.description: Rotate every page of a PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees (clockwise). Returns a file_id (for chaining) and a ~1h download URL.

tools.name: watermark_pdf
tools.description: Stamp a diagonal grey text watermark (e.g. "DRAFT", "CONFIDENTIAL") across every page of a PDF. Returns a file_id (for chaining) and a ~1h download URL.

tools.name: extract_pdf_text
tools.description: Extract the text content of a PDF — for RAG, summarization, or search. Accepts a file_id (from a prior tool) or a base64-encoded PDF, and returns the text inline. Not OCR: a scanned/image-only PDF returns little or no text.

tools.name: images_to_pdf
tools.description: Combine PNG/JPEG images (base64) into a PDF, one image per page. Returns a file_id and a ~1h URL.

tools.name: markdown_to_pdf
tools.description: Render Markdown to a clean, print-styled PDF. Returns a file_id and a ~1h URL.

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF into multiple PDFs — one per page by default, or by page ranges like '1-3;4-6'. Returns a file_id + URL per part.

tools.name: read_pdf_form
tools.description: List a PDF's form fields (name, type, value, options) as JSON.

tools.name: fill_pdf_form
tools.description: Fill a PDF's form fields from a map of field -> value; optionally flatten. Returns a file_id and a ~1h URL.

tools.name: file_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert a Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file (base64) into clean Markdown — for RAG, agents and pipelines. DOCX keeps headings/lists/tables; spreadsheets become Markdown tables (one per sheet). Returns Markdown inline. Optional 'format' (docx|xlsx|csv) overrides auto-detection.

tools.name: data_to_spreadsheet
tools.description: Turn rows of data into a downloadable XLSX (default) or CSV. 'rows' is an array of objects (keys → header row) or an array of arrays (first row is the header). Returns a file_id (for chaining) and a ~1h download URL.

tools.name: batch_scrape
tools.description: Fetch up to 10 public URLs and return each as clean Markdown, in one call — for research/RAG over several pages at once. Private/internal hosts are blocked.

tools.name: crawl_site
tools.description: Fetch a URL plus up to 7 more same-origin pages it links to (≤8 total), each as clean Markdown. Bounded and synchronous. Private/internal hosts are blocked.

tools.name: map_site
tools.description: Discover the same-origin URLs linked from a page — the site map, with no page content fetched. Private/internal hosts are blocked.

tools.name: extract_data
tools.description: Extract specified fields from a web page, PDF, or Office file as JSON, using AI. Provide 'fields' plus ONE source: a 'url', a 'pdf' (file_id or base64), or a 'file' (base64 .docx/.xlsx/.csv). Returns a JSON object mapping each field to its value, or null when absent.

tools.name: summarize_document
tools.description: Summarize a web page, PDF, Office file (.docx/.xlsx/.csv), or raw text using AI. Provide ONE source: 'url', 'pdf' (file_id or base64), 'file' (base64), or 'text'. Optional 'max_words'. Returns the summary.

tools.name: answer_from_document
tools.description: Answer a question grounded ONLY in a source document — a web page, PDF, Office file, or raw text. Provide 'question' plus ONE source: 'url', 'pdf', 'file' (base64), or 'text'. Says so when the answer isn't in the document.

tools.name: docx_to_text
tools.description: Extract the text of a .docx document (base64). Returns the text inline.

tools.name: docx_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert a .docx document (base64) to a PDF. Returns a file_id and a ~1h URL.

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Fetch a public http/https URL and return its main content as clean Markdown — ideal for giving an agent readable web content for research or RAG. Private/internal hosts are blocked.

tools.name: url_to_pdf
tools.description: Fetch a public http/https URL and render the live page to a PDF. Returns a file_id (chainable into the PDF tools) and a ~1h download URL. Private/internal hosts are blocked.

tools.name: url_to_screenshot
tools.description: Fetch a public http/https URL and capture a PNG screenshot. Set full_page for the entire scroll height. Returns a file_id and a ~1h download URL.

tools.name: scrape_page
tools.description: Fetch a public http/https URL and return its rendered HTML, the links on the page, and page metadata (title/description/OpenGraph/canonical/favicon) — in one render. For clean Markdown use read_url instead. Private/internal hosts are blocked.
